extraction.text:
Yasin Shariff

Investment Banking Professional

9940696605|ynmarriage22@gmail.com| Chennai, Tamil Nadu

Professional Summary:

Investment banking professional with 4.10 years of experience across Corporate Actions, Reconciliation, Trade Processing, and Client Operations within BFSI domain.

Currently associated with Tata Consultancy Services | Ex- BNP Paribas | Ex- Arista Consulting.

Experienced in managing corporate action events including dividends, mergers, and entitlement processing while ensuring regulatory and operational compliance. Skilled in account reconciliations based on custody requirements and handling trade matching for FX & MM products with strong focus on settlement accuracy and timely resolution of breaks.

Demonstrated leadership experience in handling team activities, supporting new joiners, managing escalations, and ensuring smooth delivery within SLA timelines in high-volume operational environments.

Education:

M.B.A. in Financial Management |University of Madras ( Correspondence)

06/2022- 06/2024 Chennai.

Bachelor of Commerce |The Quaide Milleth College for Men, University of Madras

06/2018 - 06/2021 Medavakkam, Chennai.

Current Experience:

Role: Senior Associate TCS Product: Corporate Actions and Reconciliations

Date: 28-08-2024 to 01.06.2026

Roles & Responsibilities:

Process and reconcile corporate action events including dividends, mergers, stock splits, reverse stock splits, spin-offs, tender offers, and cash merger events.

Analyze event notifications received from custodians, depositories, and agents to ensure accurate entitlement processing and execution.

Coordinate with internal teams, counterparties, and clients to resolve discrepancies and ensure timely settlement of transactions.

Monitor critical market deadlines and ensure all corporate action entitlements are captured and processed accurately within SLA timelines.



Investigate and resolve corporate action-related breaks, exceptions, and settlement issues with minimal operational risk.

Led and supported team activities by handling task allocation, assisting new joiners, and managing escalations during high-volume periods.

Prepared daily MIS reports and provided regular status updates to stakeholders and management on event progress and pending issues.

Contributed to process improvement initiatives and operational efficiency by identifying gaps and supporting automation activities.

Experience:

Role: Associate Level 1 BNP Paribas Product: Treasury FX & MM

Date: 28-02-2022 to 18.08.2024

Roles & Responsibilities:

Ensuring all process confirmation, matching and settlement are completed on timely basis. ● Communicating with external parties like counterparties custodians and clients to ensure smooth and timely settlement of both FX&MM trades.

Attending governance calls, CSM & Client calls to raise challenges on daily BAU and discussed on process exception to avoid any financial impact.

Providing Training sessions to new joiners and existing team members on product knowledge and process development.

Handled swift instructions like MT202, MT103, MT210, MT320, MT300, MT321, MT940, MT950 & MT304.

Performed matching, FX Netting and reconciliation of breaks. Maintained KPI by ensuring the data is captured accurately.

Proficient in handling Middle Office operations & Client servicing. ● Have basic knowledge in static setups, fund on boarding and client reporting. ● Actively worked on identifying and implementing process improvements, which in turn reduce manual efforts and errors.

Experience:

Role: Assistant Accountant Arista Product: Accounts

Date: 02-08-2021 to 27.02.2022

Roles & Responsibilities:

Financial Transactions & Reporting: Assist in recording, reconciling, and maintaining financial records, including accounts payable/receivable, invoices, and bank statements.

Support & Analysis: Assist senior accountants with financial analysis, audits, and month- end/year-end closing activities.

Certifications:

Derivatives -Options and Futures from interactive Brokers. ● Forex- Trading around the world from interactive Brokers. ● Financial Markets from Yale University.

Accomplishment:

Received Raising start award for the month of September 2023. ● Won gems points for best Initial learner in TCS.

Technical Skills:

Application knowledge: MS Office with focus on excel. Worked in Tradeflow Hiport Intellimatch & Swift.

Ability to manage multiple clients and products and delivered good results. Good team player and always build team bonding at workplace.

Capable of handling people and organizing team development activities. Languages aware of English, Hindi, Arabic, Urdu & Tamil.

Declaration:

I do hereby declare that the particulars of information and facts stated here in above are true to the best of my knowledge.

Place- Chennai

Yours Sincerely, Yasin Shariff
